requirements.requirement: Callable JavaScript action with committed Node 24 distribution
requirements.actualResult: action.yml points to a tracked compiled ESM runtime. CI source tests assert the declared entrypoint exists and contains the maintained action implementation.

requirements.requirement: Validated action inputs and workspace-confined paths
requirements.actualResult: Typed mode, integer, boolean, enum and list inputs fail closed. Working directories, CLI/config/manifest paths, output roots and downloaded evidence are real-path checked against GITHUB_WORKSPACE.

requirements.requirement: Credential-minimized dependency, application and Playwright lifecycle
requirements.actualResult: Dependency installation can receive registry authentication, while GitHub/Actions/registry credentials are stripped from application, ForgeQA and Playwright child processes. Owned application process groups have readiness deadlines and bounded teardown.

requirements.requirement: Bounded single-runner sharding under one worker budget
requirements.actualResult: Run mode plans once, allocates a bounded local shard pool, divides the total worker budget, preserves every shard result and merges canonical/native evidence before returning policy status.
requirements.verification: tests/github-action.test.mjs and the two-shard source action acceptance in CI run 36319982582

requirements.requirement: Reusable plan, distributed shard and aggregate merge workflow
requirements.actualResult: The reusable workflow creates one immutable manifest, executes fail-fast-disabled matrix shards with one pinned action payload, uploads complete evidence on failure and runs a stable forgeqa-quality merge job.

requirements.requirement: Strict quality and infrastructure failure propagation
requirements.actualResult: Exit codes 1, 2, 3 and 130 remain nonzero after output and evidence generation. Missing, symbolic-link, duplicate or contradictory shard evidence fails closed.

requirements.requirement: Actual local action execution against a real ForgeQA consumer
requirements.actualResult: The repository executed its tracked action through uses: ./ against a real API-only consumer with two shards, merged canonical/native evidence, verified success/test/attempt outputs and uploaded the resulting evidence package.
requirements.verification: Exact-source CI run 36319982582 action job at 570bcd08c0334cd4f9776a8846e6dda8dbdbb10b

requirements.actualResult: Least-privilege job summaries and authenticated workflow artifacts are implemented without pull_request_target or write tokens. Idempotent pull-request comment publication is not implemented.

requirements.requirement: Immutable public action release and controlled major alias
requirements.actualResult: A callable source distribution exists, but no release tag, standalone distribution-repository revision or major alias is claimed.

requirements.requirement: External consumer verifies the released immutable action
requirements.actualResult: Source-repository uses: ./ acceptance passed; a separate consumer has not yet executed an immutable released tag.
